reuse.why: The link guard is one shared prepareBankAccountLink in link.ts called by all six provider link functions, unlink reuses the extracted clearLocalBankLink, and the Akahu download was generalised into downloadSingleAccountTransactions for Fintegra; the Fintegra link body, however, is a fresh copy of the provider template rather than a shared one.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the ~70-line upgrade-or-create/sync/notify body of linkAkahuAccount, and fintegraStatus/fintegraAccounts are copies of the Akahu status/accounts handlers.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, download logic in sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Mostly focused on the four steps, but adds fintegra-status and fintegra-accounts handlers that the server-side request did not ask for.

maintainability.why: The new link rules are centralised and well documented, but a seventh copy of the per-provider link function and more copied handlers keep the provider code expensive to change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link handler calls link.prepareBankAccountLink and link.findOrCreateBank; unlinkAccount uses clearLocalBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount, fintegraStatus and fintegraAccounts in accounts/app.ts are visible near-verbatim copies of the Akahu versions, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink (accounts/link.ts) gains the replaceExistingLink parameter in step 4, which is the requested variation; all six link handlers call it, none bypass it. processBankSyncDownload in sync.ts extends the Akahu starting-balance branch with `|| 'fintegra'`.
